experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1 and 9.8 on the priced instance (last chunk, flags 3, counter t by step CT): seven outer words from the seed; the test of the work register W against WB; the 39 context lines once; clusters of 32 members (e1 bits 10-14); representative batches 0 to 3 and the last, 32 clusters; per representative the packed key and the folded two-borrow gate table, no T2 lookup on a closed gate; per opened cluster its units added to W, the representative's test (2) and paths, then its five partner batches; test (2) on T2' at word 0; the E lane with its addition to W; at a batch's first E lane the packed Y9 path, cached; T1 at word 2^34 on the cached Y9; a passing lane with its addition to W, C2.c1 and C2.b1 from the batch words, the pre-check of 9.7 and the preflight of the metered cap CM(T); the metered debit of the executed work; the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15); the root predicate; for the first certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. Table entries are computed on demand by their rules. In the same run every walked member is recomputed straight-line and its omega mod 512 tested against its cluster's two exact prefixes, every member of a closed cluster is tested bit by bit for (2), every folded gate entry against the gate table, every T2 entry used is decided bit by bit, every cached Y9 is checked against a fresh Y9 path, every passing lane's C2.c1, C2.b1 and pre-check against a scalar rebuild and every metered debit against the solver ledger, every solver call is repeated by the traversal without G15 with real-compression certificates, every E lane's step-CT message is compressed, and every 8th trial plants a joint root that both traversals must return. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, the c1 forcing t = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library is imported.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits. This is exact: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: members (walked), e_lanes (test-(2) passes), passes, solver_calls, leaves, roots, certified, units (charged machine units), solver_units (the solver ledger by nodes), opened and closed (clusters), skipped_pass (members of closed clusters that pass (2) bit by bit), checks, mismatches (a solver call above C_G(T), a metered debit that differs from the ledger, a guard word or cache entry that differs counts as one), fills (batches whose packed Y9 was built, one per batch with an E lane) and halted. Expected per trial: 32 clusters, about 45% opened (proved bound 0.4483), about 480 walked members, 53 E lanes in 23 filled batches and 0.9 passes, about 0.28 solver calls per pass, almost always no root; skipped_pass, mismatches and halted 0. In the participant's local run of this request: 3,690 of 8,192 clusters opened, 122,582 members walked, 13,481 E lanes, 5,874 fills, 225 passes, 64 solver calls, no root, 450,538 checks, 0 skipped passes, 0 mismatches. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
